title: Bertoni 2024 preprint · Bedside arm PPS
citation: Bertoni et al. (2024). Multisensory integration in Peripersonal Space indexes consciousness states in sleep and disorders of consciousness. bioRxiv v1.
notes: Preprint study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.tactile: MEDEL MOTIONSTIM 8 functional electrical stimulation on the right extensor digitorum communis with shoulder ground. 50 ms train at 35 Hz and 70% of measured motor threshold.
published_method.response: Passive task with clinical classification and outcomes recorded separately.
published_method.analysis: Apply the high-beta PPS index to CRS-R, cognitive-motor dissociation, functional outcomes and any available MRI measures. Methods specify first sessions, but the description of exclusions and pooled sessions leaves the denominator unresolved.
